capabilities: Align blank line, heading and list spacing with Reading view
Keep callouts rendered while the cursor is inside them
Show code fences and heading marks only on the active line
Render footnote references as superscripts and center images
Measure per-line pixel offsets between the two modes
extras: Not yet listed in the community directory; install manually by copying main.js, manifest.json and styles.css into <vault>/.obsidian/plugins/mode-parity/. Pixel parity verified only on Obsidian 1.15.1 with the default theme; other themes are calibrated automatically but not hand-verified, and mobile is untested. Syntax highlighting colors still differ between modes, and hanging ## marks can be clipped in very narrow panes.
problem: In stock Obsidian the same note looks different in Live Preview and Reading view: blank lines, headings, lists, code blocks and callouts shift position or revert to raw markup while editing.
summary: Plugin that aligns Live Preview spacing with Reading view to the pixel and keeps callouts rendered while editing them.
